scope: Proposed framework- and storage-neutral upload/download behavior for Dufs and Photo Backup
compliance_claim: An implementation is not conformant until every must requirement has executable behavior evidence.

requirements.summary: Length, ordered part boundaries and lowercase 256-bit content digests are validated before commit.
A retry reuses a caller-visible operation identity and cannot create a second committed object.
Clients can query durable received progress without retransmitting the body.
Loss of the commit response is represented as unknown and reconciled before any replay.
Committed content is complete and verified; partial data remains staging data and is never served as committed.
Adapters expose the stable error classes defined by this contract without trusting an unverified response body.
Committed bytes support correct HEAD and single byte-range behavior, including 206 and 416.
Metrics cover active transfers, staged bytes, commit latency, recovery backlog and quota rejection without logging credentials or user paths.

non_goals: A shared filesystem or object-store implementation
A shared SQL schema or transaction manager
A common Axum or Hyper handler
Equating Dufs paths with Photo Backup assets
